subject: Recap: Renewal & expansion call — pilot → dedicated capacity path
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Turner <emma@aperturehealth.com>; Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Renewal & expansion call — pilot → dedicated capacity path

Hi Emma / Liam — thanks again for a constructive conversation today. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment and clear next steps.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Current pain: inconsistent latency for batch inference on PeakHours (especially imaging ingestion), rising token costs on spiky workloads, and audit readiness for SSO/audit logs.
- Goal: stabilize latency for critical inference paths (95th %ile < 250ms for 512-token sequences), move high-volume workloads off shared hosted capacity to a Dedicated pool, and simplify compliance evidence for upcoming vendor audit in November.

Proposed path we discussed
1) 30-day dedicated pilot: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs, reserved for your clinical triage model (inference-only workload). Run parallel traffic split (10% live → pilot) to validate latency and performance.
2) Usage review + MAP: During pilot we’ll deliver a per-route token cost and KV-cache hit analysis; we attached a draft mutual action plan (RW-MAP-Aperture-Health.pdf).
3) Post-pilot expansion: if pilot meets latency/cost SLOs, convert to a reserved Dedicated pool (quarterly commitment) and enable audit logging + KMS integration for production.

Open questions & clarifications (please confirm):
- Exact SLO target: do you want 95th %ile at 250ms or 200ms for the triage path? We scoped 250ms during the call but can tighten if needed.
- Compliance: Emma — you mentioned SOC2 scoping and a pref for KMS; I attached a short evidence summary (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf). Is additional attestation required for the November audit?
- Timeline: you suggested starting pilot the week of Sep 6. Confirm if that still works for your infra team.

Next steps (owner/ETA)
- Monica: share MAP + usage snapshot + HubSpot deal link (today) — attached.
- Emma: confirm pilot start week and SLO target (by Mon 8/24).
- Rishi: draft a dedicated pilot pricing estimate and reservation options (by Tue 8/25).

Attachments: RW-MAP-Aperture-Health.pdf, aperture-usage-Q2-2026.csv, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick 20-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Monica — this is really helpful and captures the call well. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) SLO: let's start with 250ms 95th for the triage path. If the pilot shows consistent headroom, we can target 200ms in production.
2) Pilot start: Sep 7 (Monday) works for our infra team — they need the pilot credentials and a short onboarding doc.
3) Compliance: SOC2 is in-scope; KMS integration is required. For the vendor audit we will need the following artifacts: audit logs for inference requests, evidence of KMS key rotation policy, and a short runbook for incident response.

On licensing/pricing: Liam and I would like to see a pilot rate and a projected monthly committed cost if we convert to a 12-month reserved pool. Can Rishi include a breakout for token costs vs fixed GPU reservation in the estimate?
